name: IC Memory — SPI — DFN
description: Cluster of 4 surface-mount memory ICs with SPI interface in a DFN package family utilizing the DFN-8-1EP_3x2mm_P0.5mm_EP1.75x1.45mm footprint.
selection_hints: Select when requiring an SPI memory IC in a surface-mount DFN package.
Choose among Tier A parts like 25LCxxx-MC, AT25xxx-MA, BR25xxx-NUX, or CAT250xxx-HU4.
avoid_when: Avoid if the design requires non-DFN packages or non-SMD mounting.
Do not use if a communication interface other than SPI is required.
Avoid when the targeted footprint differs from DFN-8-1EP_3x2mm_P0.5mm_EP1.75x1.45mm.
